summary: Added the ratelimit stage (client address resolution, keys, covering/deciding limit, headers, 429, rl_refused summary) and put it in STAGES between auth and upstream. Fixed the earlier code against the spec: float arithmetic in Bucket.refill, strict CIDR/ASCII-digit parsing for networks and per, case-insensitive duplicate header key parts, empty routes/methods lists. One existing test (tests/test_ratelimit.py::test_token_bucket) still fails because it reads summary key 'limited', but the spec requires 'rl_refused'; tests were not changed.
